summary.text: Brett Smith, a Molalla resident, former welder, mill worker and maintenance man, and Pacific Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Oregon to Tina Kotek.

He ran for Oregon’s 5th Congressional District in 2024 as the Independent Party nominee and received nearly 5 percent of the vote; as of September 16, OPB reported he had not reported raising any money.
He received 2.9% of the vote to Kotek’s 53.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Oregon governor race third-party candidate Brett Smith
